The period shall run only from the time when all documentation has been submitted. The extension and its duration shall be duly motivated and shall be notified to the applicant before the original period has expired.

Authorisation procedures and formalities shall provide applicants with a guarantee that their application will be processed as quickly as possible and, in any event, within a reasonable period which is fixed and made public in advance. The period shall run only from the time when all documentation has been submitted. When justified by the complexity of the issue, the time period may be extended once, by the competent authority, for a limited time. The extension and its duration shall be duly motivated and shall be notified to the applicant before the original period has expired.
rew_raw:
The authorisation shall be granted as soon as the competent authorities confirm, after a proper review, that all the required conditions have been met.  

Except when granting an authorisation, any decision made by the competent authorities, including refusals, must be based on clear and fair reasons.  

Authorisation procedures must not discourage applicants or make it too difficult or slow to start a service. These procedures must be easy to understand and access. Any fees applicants may pay must be reasonable, directly related to the actual cost of processing their application, and must not go beyond the real cost of the procedure.  

Applicants must be given a clear guarantee that their application will be handled as quickly as possible. The processing time must be fixed in advance and made public. This time starts only after all required documents have been submitted. In some cases, if the issue is particularly complex, the competent authority may extend the deadline once, for a limited period. This extension must be clearly explained and notified to the applicant before the original deadline expires.
